www-7489441.description: Note: It is highly recommended that you play this game on PC due to the amount of lag mobile users may face while playing this game. Use, "?local=1" to play by yourself! This is a single player action-adventure/puzzle game, where your goal is to solve puzzles and collect all of the Stars that are on top of each of the Castles. Collect all of the Stars from all 3 games in order to fully beat the game! The game can be played with more than one person, but it is highly recommended that you play by yourself if you want a greater challenge! FULL WALKTHROUGH (remove the spaces): http://kogama .freeforums .net/thread/19869/floating-land-trilogy-full-walkthrough This game took several hours to make, (more than you probably think). Good luck to all! :D ~LinkkysCreations
